articles.author: Thibault Spirlet
articles.title: Europe is warming to America's obsession with staying cool - Business Insider
articles.description: As Europe recorded its hottest June on record, Europeans flocked to buy AC units, eroding a decades-old divide with America.
articles.content:
Europe may finally be admitting Americans had a point.
